sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in a strong position and will be heavy favourites against Alsager, who sit bottom of the division with just 4 points from 10 matches and have won only once all season.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to bounce back from their own recent loss and close the narrow 2-point gap to the leaders. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, travel to Eccleshall in what should be a competitive mid-table encounter. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points in fourth, visit Wednesfield Community on Saturday before hosting Brereton Social on Wednesday; Casuals' recent form has been encouraging with three wins in their last five. Eccleshall will be keen to extend their strong recent run when they host AFC Bridgnorth. Bilston Town, fifth-placed and in-form, face Foley Meir at home. In the basement, Widnes Town (bottom, 2 points) travel to Brereton Social seeking an upset, while Telford Town, second from bottom with 6 points, visit Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday. Shawbury United, winless in their last five matches, host Barnton, who arrive in decent form. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a lower-table clash, and Market Drayton Town visit New Mills, both sides looking to string together consistent results.
